race.title: Exminster Golf Club Supporting Elf Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Things couldn't be going much better for Jamie Snowden and his KEL DU LARGE gets the verdict to open his account over the larger obstacles with his reappearance under his belt. He Knows Better could be the one to give the selection most to think about on reappearance following a breathing operation, with recent winner Sage Green taken to edge out It's A Breeze for minor honours. KEL DU LARGE (FR) HE KNOWS BETTER (IRE) SAGE GREEN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Sage Green (9/4), Start Again (7/2), Koukeo (9/2), He Knows Better (5/1), Kel Du Large (11/2), It's A Breeze (11/2), Another Folly (10/1), Kingcormac (12/1), Bonza Boy (12/1), Fight My Fire (16/1)
